metadata.notes: Direct USB ALSA retest resolved the transport mapping: B9 57 03 arms all channels in overdub/overburn mode; BA 57 03 starts playback; BB 57 03 stops transport. Any previous interpretation of B9 as REC was incorrect and has been superseded. Scene SAVE is confirmed: B9 56 03 saves the currently selected scene over USB ALSA. BB 56 03 was tested and selects scene 1; it is not DELETE. Scene DELETE remains unknown. Correction from direct hardware retest: BD 56 03 selects scene 3. The earlier interpretation as entering scene mode was incorrect. Additional scene mapping confirmed over USB ALSA: BC 56 03 -> scene 2; BE 56 03 -> scene 4; BF 56 03 -> scene 5; B4 57 03 -> RESET. Official L12next MIDI table resolves the remaining scene controls: BC 59 03 = Scene 10, BD 59 03 = Scene Delete (value 03 follows verified button press convention). It also identifies B9 57 as RECORD BUTTON and BE 57 as OVERDUB MODE. CH1 fader confirmed from capture: B0 3C vv. Observed settled values: -inf=00, ~-20dB=1D, ~-10dB=35, 0dB=57. Fader control confirmed over USB ALSA: CH1=B0 3C vv, CH2=B1 3C vv. General pattern is Bn 3C vv for CH1..CH16 with absolute 7-bit values. Dedicated BLE REC/STOP capture reconfirmed state feedback: B8 57 05 = REC active, B8 57 00 = stopped. These are feedback/state messages, distinct from the control command B9 57 03. Scene 1 mapping canonicalized: BB 56 03 is the verified selector. The older B7 57 03 entry was removed as erroneous/obsolete. CALL scene 1 is SELECT (BB 56 03) followed by RECALL (BA 56 03).

commands.name: RECORD
commands.description: RECORD BUTTON according to the official L12next MIDI implementation (CC 0x57, MIDI channel 10). On the tested mixer this was observed to arm channels while Overdub mode was active.

commands.name: STOP
commands.description: Stops playback/transport. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Starts playback ('PLAY SOUND'). Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: FF
commands.description: Fast-forward command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: REW
commands.description: Rewind command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_3
commands.description: Selects scene 3. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_RECALL
commands.description: Triggers RECALL for the currently selected scene. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_7
commands.description: Selects scene 7; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_6
commands.description: Selects scene 6; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_8
commands.description: Selects scene 8; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_9
commands.description: Selects scene 9; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: RESET
commands.description: Triggers RESET. Reconfirmed by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_1
commands.description: Selects scene 1. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test. To CALL/activate scene 1, follow with SCENE_RECALL (BA 56 03).

commands.name: OVERDUB_MODE
commands.description: OVERDUB MODE button according to the official L12next MIDI implementation (CC 0x57, MIDI channel 15).

commands.name: SCENE_SAVE
commands.description: Saves the currently selected scene. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_2
commands.description: Selects scene 2. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_4
commands.description: Selects scene 4. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_5
commands.description: Selects scene 5. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_10
commands.description: Selects scene 10. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: SCENE_DELETE
commands.description: Scene DELETE. Official L12next MIDI implementation lists CC 0x59 on MIDI channel 14 for Scene Delete. Value 03 matches the verified button-press convention; destructive hardware replay not yet performed.

commands.name: CH1_FADER
commands.description: Channel 1 fader, absolute 7-bit value. Verified via USB ALSA. Captured reference values: -inf=00, ~-20dB=1D, ~-10dB=35, 0dB=57.

commands.name: CH2_FADER
commands.description: Channel 2 fader, absolute 7-bit value. Verified via USB ALSA.

commands.name: CHANNEL_FADER_PATTERN
commands.description: General fader pattern: MIDI status Bn selects mixer channel (n=0..15 => CH1..CH16), CC 0x3C, vv is absolute 7-bit fader position. Verified on CH1 and CH2 and generalized from MIDI channel mapping.

commands.name: REC_STATE_ACTIVE
commands.description: Mixer/app feedback observed during REC state. In the dedicated REC/STOP BLE capture, B8 57 05 appears immediately after the REC operation and is treated as recording-active feedback.

commands.name: REC_STATE_STOPPED
commands.description: Mixer/app feedback observed for stopped recording/transport state. In the dedicated REC/STOP BLE capture, B8 57 00 appears after STOP and is treated as recording-stopped feedback.
